title: Compatible finite orbit model
statement: Let H and C be commutative rings with an H-algebra structure, G a group, and ρ : G → (C →ₐ[H] C) satisfy ρ(a*b) = ρ(a).comp(ρ(b)). Given α : G →* Equiv.Perm (Fin d) and FixedOrbitData D with D.action = α, there exist m and K : Fin m → Subgroup G such that the H-algebra of α-equivariant functions is H-algebra equivalent to the product of the ρ(K k)-fixed subalgebras, and an equivalence e : Fin m ≃ Fin D.m with K k = D.stabilizer (e k) for all k. In fact take m = D.m and K = D.stabilizer.

proof.text: Take m = D.m and K = D.stabilizer. Completeness chooses an orbit index and transporter for every coordinate; distinctness makes the index invariant under α. Evaluation at D.representative is an H-algebra homomorphism into the product of stabilizer equalizers.

If two transporters reach the same point, their quotient stabilizes its representative. Apply ρ of one transporter to the fixed-value equality and use hρmul to prove independence. Extend fixed values by the chosen transporters. Independence proves equivariance and surjectivity; equivariance proves injectivity. Apply AlgEquiv.ofBijective and use the identity index equivalence for compatibility.

proof_origin.note: Second reader: complete evaluation/extension proof adapted from EquivariantOrbitModel to the prescribed orbit representatives. No postponed statement.

lean.statement:
theorem equivariant_orbit_model_compatible
    (H C : Type u) [CommRing H] [CommRing C] [Algebra H C]
    (G : Type u) [Group G] (ρ : G → C →ₐ[H] C)
    (hρmul : ∀ a b, ρ (a * b) = (ρ a).comp (ρ b))
    (d : ℕ) (α : G →* Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (D : FixedOrbitData G d)
    (hD : D.action = α) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (K : Fin m → Subgroup G),
      Nonempty ((affineTorsorEquivariantAlgebra H C G ρ d α) ≃ₐ[H]
        (∀ k : Fin m,
          (⨅ ζ : K k, AlgHom.equalizer (ρ ζ.val) (AlgHom.id H C) : Subalgebra H C))) ∧
      ∃ e : Fin m ≃ Fin D.m, ∀ k, K k = D.stabilizer (e k)
